headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: Sales volume declined 9.8% YoY to 37Mn pairs in Q2 FY27, whereas average realization improved 23.2% to Rs 186 per pair following calibrated price hikes and mix shift.

However, the management declined to reaffirm its earlier 100 bps FY27 margin expansion guidance, indicating profitability will stay under near-term pressure until geopolitical conditions stabilize, while prioritizing manufacturing productivity and cost optimization to support bottom-line recovery.

We downgrade the stock to HOLD a TP of Rs316, assigning 38x PER on FY28E.  Yet another quarter of subdued sales volume: Net sales rose by 11.6% YoY to Rs7,016Mn as higher average realizations offset volume contraction in mass-market open footwear categories.
EBITDA increased 5.1% YoY to Rs853Mn while EBITDA margin contracted 76 bps YoY to 12.2% due to raw material inflation and higher statutory minimum wages.
watch: We have revised our earnings estimates downwards given weak H1FY27 and bleak outlook for H2FY27.
